provenance.note: Reused verbatim as the shared predicate vocabulary; each predicate carries the relational_domain used by the multi-relational completeness (MRC) audit. Verification status and method are the E1 registry's own; nothing re-verified here.

predicates.label: bearer of
predicates.relational_note: independent continuant -> specifically dependent continuant (quality, role, disposition)
predicates.source: BFO 2020 (as imported by CCO 2.0 merged)
predicates.definition: b bearer of c =Def c inheres in b
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has continuant part
predicates.source: BFO 2020 (as imported by CCO 2.0 merged)
predicates.definition: b has continuant part c =Def c continuant part of b
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has participant
predicates.source: BFO 2020 (as imported by CCO 2.0 merged)
predicates.definition: p has participant c =Def c participates in p
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has output
predicates.relational_note: process -> continuant produced by the process
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x has output y =Def y is output of x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has input
predicates.relational_note: process -> continuant consumed/used as input (in this vocabulary: information content)
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x has input y =Def y is input of x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: is cause of
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x is_cause_of y iff x and y are instances of Process, and y is a consequence of x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: precedes
predicates.source: BFO 2020 (as imported by CCO 2.0 merged)
predicates.definition: (Elucidation) precedes is a relation between occurrents o, o' such that if t is the temporal extent of o & t' is the temporal extent of o' then either the last instant of o is before the first instant of o' or the last instant of o is the first instant of o' & neither o nor o' are temporal instants
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: realizes
predicates.source: BFO 2020 (as imported by CCO 2.0 merged)
predicates.definition: (Elucidation) realizes is a relation between a process b and realizable entity c such that c inheres in some d & for all t, if b has participant d then c exists & the type instantiated by b is correlated with the type instantiated by c
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has agent
predicates.relational_note: process -> Agent playing a causative role
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x has agent y =Def y agent in x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: uses
predicates.relational_note: Agent -> material entity leveraged in a process
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x uses y iff x is an instance of an Agent and y is an instance of a Material Entity, such that both x and y participate in some instance of a Process wherein x attempts to accomplish a goal by manipulating, deploying, or leveraging some attribute of y.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has recipient
predicates.relational_note: Act of Communication -> Agent receiving it
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x has recipient y =Def y receives x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: is about
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x is_about y is a primitive relationship between an instance of Information Content Entity x and an instance of Entity y.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: is a measurement of
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x is_a_measurement_of y iff x is an instance of Measurement Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x describes some attribute of y relative to some scale or classification scheme.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: prescribes
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x prescribes y iff x is an instance of Information Content Entity and y is an instance of Entity, such that x serves as a rule or guide for y if y an Occurrent, or x serves as a model for y if y is a Continuant.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has organizational context
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x has organizational context y =Def y is organizational context of x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: is subordinate role to
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: For all x,y,t: y is subordinate role to x at t iff: x is an instance of Role at time t, and y is an instance of Role at time t, and there is some z such that x is realized by z and z is an instance of Process which creates, modifies, transfers, or eliminates some u such that u is a Process Regulation at time t, and u is addressed to the bearer of y.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: is affiliated with
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x is_affiliated_with y iff x and y are instances of Agent, such that they have any kind of social or business relationship.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: affects
predicates.relational_note: process -> entity influenced by it (here: persons/organizations touched by a process)
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x affects y =Def y is affected by x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: has interest in
predicates.relational_note: Agent -> process in which the agent has an interest
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: A relation between an Agent and some Process where the Agent has an interest in that Process.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib

predicates.label: supervises
predicates.source: CCO 2.0 Extended Relation Ontology / Agent Ontology (merged file)
predicates.definition: x supervises y =Def y is supervised by x.
predicates.verification_method: label+IRI+definition+domain+range+parent read from CommonCoreOntologiesMerged.ttl via rdflib
